package.name: biguasim_bridge
package.description: Normalizes BiguaSim's custom / polar sensor messages into standard ROS 2 types you can inspect and view in RViz2: * odom_bridge_node : DynamicsSensor/Odom -> PoseStamped + TwistStamped * sonar_bridge_node: ImagingSonar (polar 32FC1) -> sensor_msgs/Image (mono8 Cartesian fan) Pure Python (rclpy + numpy). Starting point -- topic names and geometry conventions are parameters.
